notes: GEOINT: a new tab that works out where a photograph was taken. It reads the file’s own GPS tag when there is one, and otherwise recognises the picture itself — architecture, landscape and signage — narrowing to a shortlist of countries and then to real towns with coordinates you can copy. Drop a picture in, or just paste one with Ctrl+V. A Street view button drops straight into Google’s 360 view of whatever you pick. The whole mode is black and white with a bigger map. 10 tokens a scan.
